The '''Deactivated Camp''' was a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] base built during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. It contained the forces of the [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|droid]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[OOM-14/Legends|OOM-14]], which were rendered immobile by the loss of a [[droid control program]] until it was recovered by the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|droid]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]].

==Description==
The Deactivated Camp was built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during the company's [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the world in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. It contained a single [[command center]] built on a [[Grass/Legends|grassy]] area south of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Harte Secur]]. A stone path began at the east of the camp and stretched north to Harte Secur. The camp was surrounded by herds of [[Falumpaset/Legends|falumpasets]] and [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]], and the surrounding area included natural resources such as [[Muja fruit/Legends|muja fruit]] [[Bush/Legends|bushes]], [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]], and [[Ore/Legends|ore]] deposits.<ref name="GB" />

==History==
{{Quote|Without it, a subset of our formidable battle droids stand motionless on the battlefield.|Nute Gunray, speaking of the lost droid control program and the droids at the Deactivated Camp|audio=Deactivated.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Force_Command_Two.png|thumb|right|270px|The capture of the droid control program deactivated the battle droids at the camp.]]
The camp belonged to the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[OOM-14/Legends|OOM-14]], who was in charge of one of five [[droid control program]]s that were necessary to keep the Federation's [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|droids]] active. OOM-14 lost the program to the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] unit [[Force Command Two]], and it was taken to a Harte Secur [[Research Center]] and used to deactivate OOM-14's<ref name="GB" /> [[Division/Legends|division]],<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> numbering 72 B1-Series [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and eight [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|missile battle droids]], at the camp.<ref name="GB" />

[[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] tasked the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] with retrieving the droid control program, sending him to the Deactivated Camp along with a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Unidentified Neimoidian technician (Harte Secur)|technician]]. OOM-9 and a small force of droids [[Capture of Harte Secur|raided]] the research center and reacquired the droid control program, bringing it to the camp and reactivating the droids there. Afterward, OOM-9 used the droids to destroy Harte Secur,<ref name="GB" /> remaining at the camp along with five B1 battle droids&mdash;which he garrisoned inside the command center&mdash;two missile droids, and the [[Technician/Legends|technician]].<ref name="Prima" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Establish a base of operations.|Nute Gunray in an unused audio file|audio=EstablishBase.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The Deactivated Camp was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima" /> released on [[November 7]], [[2001]].<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref> It appeared and was identified in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> The Deactivated Camp is featured in the second level of the Trade Federation campaign, "Behind the Lines," where its command center becomes available to the player after retrieving the droid control program.<ref name="GB" />

The player can create [[OX9]] [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droids]], with which they can create more buildings and expand their [[Army/Legends|army]].<ref name="GB" /> However, the strategy guide states that creating extra units is unnecessary as the battle droids acquired upon retrieving the program are sufficient to achieve victory.<ref name="Prima" /> Unused audio files from the level feature Gunray instructing the player to establish a camp and gather resources.<ref name="GB" />
